fonts.display: 'HelveticaNeuePro', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'HelveticaNeuePro', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Canvas White
palette.role: Page background, card surface, image plate — the entire site sits on pure white

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: All text, hairline borders, navigation, link underlines, image frames — the sole structural color

palette.name: Terminal Lime
palette.role: Footer band, surface highlight wash, terminal accent — high-chroma green that signals a page boundary the way a colored edge stops a gallery wall

palette.name: Signal Red
palette.role: Decorative border strokes, icon outlines, hairline rules in editorial layouts — used at sub-readable contrast as graphic punctuation, never as body text
